alex_w: quick repro - kernel-picker picks flashattn-v2 for causal seq=512 on sm86, but we hit the slowpath 3x slower when headdim=48 :confused:

alex_w: repro steps pasted below, includes perf counters and the exact kernel selection log

maria_g: can you drop the env + bench command? want to run locally

alex_w: yes - running on sm86, cuda 12.2, torch 2.2, model: llama-ish, heads=32, head_dim=48, seq=512, kv-cache enabled. bench cmd:
```
./prof_bench --model=llama-mini --batch=1 --seq=512 --heads=32 --head-dim=48 --kv-cache
```
profile snippet:
```
kernel_picker: chosen=flashattn-v2_causal (probe_score=73)
kernel_launcher: fallback->sdpa_slow (reason=tile_mismatch)
perf: token/ms=0.18 (expected ~0.6)
```

ryan_s: interesting - does kv-cache prefetch change seqlen distribution at probe time? could be that warmup uses short prefixes and picks a kernel tuned for short seq

alex_w: exactly - after a few warmup tokens the runtime switches to longer effective seq due to cached K/V, and v2's tiling assumptions break for head_dim=48 on sm86

benchbot: auto-profile attached: flashattn-v1: 0.62 t/ms, flashattn-v2: 0.58 t/ms (non-causal), flashattn-v2_causal: 0.21 t/ms (observed), sdpa_slow: 0.19 t/ms

samir_k: head_dim=48 is non-16-aligned; we see fragmentation in our tiler. two quick options: 1) remap head_dim to nearest 16 multiple for kernel-picker heuristics (no real quant impact, just eval for perf decision), or 2) add a cheap runtime microprobe that runs a 1-iter kernel check for current seq/head combo during start-up

maria_g: +1 to microprobe. remap feels like a heuristic that might hide correctness issues. microprobe could be gated by a short timeout and avoided on tight-latency paths

alex_w: threw together a tiny guard in the autotuner: run a 64-token microprobe of the selected kernel and compare throughput to baseline. if throughput < threshold then try alternate kernel. patch snippet:
```
if (probe_time[selected] > baseline*1.5) {
  try_alternates();
}
```

ryan_s: can we make the microprobe architecture-aware? e.g., sample different tile sizes for sm86 vs sm90 and cache result per-device to avoid repeated probes

samir_k: yep - store per-device map keyed by (arch, heads, head_dim_mod16, seq_bucket) -> preferred_kernel. TTL ~ 24h to pick up driver/hw changes

deploy-bot: staging rollout queued for kernel-picker microprobe feature (canary=10%). watch perf dashboards for regression alerts :eyes:

maria_g: thanks. i'll add a small eval harness with our Llama-ish prompt set to ensure quality/regression checks before prod rollout

alex_w: i'll open PR with the microprobe + per-device cache and include the bench logs. thx everyone :thumbsup:
